observations.behavior: Removes model-specific free-tier configuration and its associated 403 rejection behavior; no longer passes an explicit agent_model argument.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes how eval harnesses invoke their local LLM gateway, removing reliance on per-run billing exemptions that could cause false negatives in evaluation.

observations.behavior: Adds OAuth setup command execution before database queries, with a blocker unblock guard. This ensures tokens are minted for the posthog_ai origin used by demo cases.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes demo data seeding compatible with token-based authentication required when tasks originate from PostHog AI, preventing silent failures during case initialization.

observations.behavior: Passes a fixed TaskOriginProduct value into task creation and workflow entry points, establishing a consistent product identity for all eval runs.
observations.posthog_connection: Establishes traceability of evaluation workloads within the broader PostHog platform, potentially enabling shared accounting or routing without changing underlying implementation.

observations.limitations: Only three hunks examined; other changes not reviewed. No tests or end-to-end checks shown. The removed model-specific configuration is not independently verified as harmless across all callers.

review.limitations: Only three hunks examined; other changes not reviewed. No tests or end-to-end checks shown. The removed model-specific configuration is not independently verified as harmless across all callers.
review.reason: Changes demonstrate bounded capability improvements: OAuth setup compatibility, removal of brittle free-tier bypass, and establishment of consistent product identity. These could support reliable evaluation workflows but do not show systemic risk reduction or broad architectural change.
review.posthog_relevance: Could help maintain correctness of internal eval harnesses that depend on proper OAuth and gateway behavior while avoiding false negatives due to billing gate rejections.
review.uncertainty: Other hunks may contain additional relevant or unrelated changes. No test execution results provided.
